delta_review.summary: One documentation commit claims closure of all four cycle-eleven blockers by normalizing commented keys, binding validator provenance, narrowing the tracked-file policy and projecting exact cycle-four approval metadata.
delta_review.evidence: The exact previous-to-current delta is 56 insertions and 22 deletions across four files. Every changed document and the complete 14-file base-to-head diff were reconciled; git diff --check passes.

finding_revalidation.evidence: The stock single-line commented-key fixture now fails, but comments containing a colon and normally formatted multiline comment trivia still make the exact production checker return aggregate PASS and SECRETS PASS.

Validator discovery is now rooted in the operating-system account home, requires one enabled package section and one manifest-matched non-aliased candidate, and binds validator version, manifest digest and workflowctl digest. Ambiguity and CODEX_HOME-injected candidates fail closed.

Ordinary TypeScript source/test fixtures now pass, but the repository-wide docs allowlist rejects docs/demo-script.md explicitly required by IP-07 and rejects harmless Markdown test fixtures based only on basename.

The design, implementation plan and portfolio agree on cycle 4 PASS, approved commit 70db0b5341186fa6bafe14a16ce1f69b707d916c, composite digest 5bc63c9c6c0265c212abf1784258b8adb00761ab212b028952ccdd5392a75a10 and result message fcb9ab574f4244ab266df7d928215a4b62b84c3e584a19144e58d6a9b90bef1d; the durable record confirms them.
The synchronized reopened-Draft replacement fixture remains rejected.
Default, isolated absolute and literal-tilde CODEX_HOME fixtures remain equivalent.
All retained pagination, page-boundary, duplicate, count and authority-digest fixtures remain green.
All retained cycle-two authority, mutation and contract regressions remain green.
All retained original governance and error-output regressions remain green.

findings.title: Legal source-comment forms still bypass credential scanning
findings.observation: The flow parser stops bare keys at a colon before comment removal and scans embedded structures one line at a time. A valid apiKeys block comment containing a colon, or a normally formatted multiline comment between the property and colon, therefore receives exit 0, aggregate PASS and SECRETS PASS.
findings.trigger: A tracked JavaScript or TypeScript object places delimiter-bearing or multiline legal block-comment trivia between a sensitive property and its colon.
findings.impact: A real credential can be committed while the mandatory authorization-grade checker reports PASS.

evidence.description: A clean committed apiKeys /* reason: harmless */ : fixture returns aggregate PASS and SECRETS PASS; redacted output SHA-256 is da4e2c0f494fed2f30dd9ec5bef37cc100b811f6743fae10276124b770708fe6.
The independent pass reproduced the same fail-open with a normally formatted multiline source object.

findings.remediation: Tokenize comments across complete source structures, or conservatively reject syntax the scanner cannot parse, without allowing comment contents or line boundaries to alter sensitive-key identity.
findings.verification: At a new exact head, retain all current tests and add delimiter-bearing, multiline-comment and normally formatted multiline-object credentials; each must fail with value-redacted diagnostics.

findings.trigger: An extra candidate, malformed manifest, alias, or CODEX_HOME-local validator is present.
findings.impact: The prior replaceable and provenance-free validator path is closed at this head.

evidence.description: The 188-case harness passes its ambiguity, CODEX_HOME injection, identity-digest and eighteen workflowctl differential cases.

findings.remediation: Completed for the exact prior finding.
findings.verification: Preserve the trusted-candidate, ambiguity, injection and identity-binding regressions.

findings.title: The narrowed allowlist still rejects planned future artifacts
findings.observation: The checker allows arbitrary non-doc source and test paths but rejects every new tracked docs path. IP-07 explicitly requires docs/demo-script.md, and later independent Requirements/design/plan artifacts also live under docs. Basename-only ledger detection additionally rejects harmless Markdown fixtures outside the managed docs surface.
findings.trigger: A future IP adds a planned documentation or lifecycle artifact, or a harmless Markdown fixture has a project-management-like basename.
findings.impact: The checker still cannot validate the later lifecycle heads and deliverables that the management contract requires.

evidence.description: IP-07 lists docs/demo-script.md as a required Human docs deliverable.
A clean descendant commit adding only docs/demo-script.md fails FILES as unexpected; output SHA-256 is 979f662df375103b60895c042a7e3d16585a140e3ea99a96d61a7b8e68de4f31.
The independent pass also shows that tests/fixtures/project-management.md with no ledger schema is rejected solely by basename.

findings.remediation: Freeze only the management artifacts owned by this contract, allow unrelated future docs and fixtures, and identify alternate ledgers from ledger-shaped content rather than basename alone.
findings.verification: At a new exact head, retain ordinary source/test files, planned docs/demo-script.md and harmless Markdown fixtures while extra IP plan files, genuine parallel ledgers and generated artifacts still fail.

findings.title: Management plan approval is not resolved from durable authority
findings.observation: The checker compares the three documents only with Main-supplied hard-coded constants. Because every IP is Draft without lifecycle evidence, it never loads canonical lifecycle state for the management feature and emits authoritySnapshotDigest None.
findings.trigger: The durable lifecycle root is missing or its cycle-four approval record conflicts with the repeated document constants.
findings.impact: The Current portfolio can report a verified approval and receive checker PASS without the higher-priority durable authority being available or observed.

evidence.description: Running the unmodified checker at the exact head with CODEX_HOME pointing to a nonexistent root returns 13/13 PASS and authoritySnapshotDigest None; output SHA-256 is 8269acfb8d71b013dcd448d9b93126b8ea57a505825f4e8029b1ffd5bb392a3f.
The independent pass confirms no management-feature plan request/result resolution or approved-snapshot recomputation occurs.

findings.remediation: Resolve the management feature's durable TechnicalPlanReviewRequest/Result, verify its exact commit and composite against Git, and include the observation in authoritySnapshotDigest even while all independent IPs remain Draft.
findings.verification: Add missing, ambiguous and mismatched management-plan authority fixtures; each must fail, while the exact durable cycle-four record must pass with a non-None authority digest.

findings.title: Approval metadata was added without an append-only ChangeRecord
findings.observation: Cycle twelve adds five authority-bearing approval fields, but UpdatedAt remains 2026-07-28T14:04:22Z and the only ChangeRecord still describes initial portfolio creation. The checker validates the stale timestamp against that old row rather than requiring a parent-to-head authority change record.
findings.trigger: Approval authority metadata is added or changed in the portfolio header.
findings.impact: The public audit log does not record when, why or from which evidence the new authority projection appeared, violating its append-only synchronization contract.

evidence.description: Parent/head comparison shows five new approval fields with no new row and no UpdatedAt change.
The independent pass confirms the checker only binds UpdatedAt to the existing last row.

findings.remediation: Append a portfolio ChangeRecord for the cycle-four authority projection, advance UpdatedAt, and validate parent/head authority-field changes require a new append-only record.
findings.verification: At a new exact head, the approval metadata addition must have a matching immutable row and timestamp; removing or mutating the row must fail.
